activity_summary: On the corner of the table you added the fourth line to Sunday's three. The tooth is out, the king draws, and you are well. You did not write a Christmas promise, and you did not write Daniel into the letter.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the line on the corner and signed it.

entities.name: Thomas Hobbins
entities.context: Waited while the ink was wet enough to read.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: The person the paper is for. She is not at the table.
